info.title: LimitGuard.ai
info.description: Free sandbox key, no wallet. $0.65-0.85 fresh; $0.10 cached when available. Trust Intelligence API: entity verification, risk scoring, KYB and compliance, paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana).
info.x-guidance:
Free sandbox key, no wallet: POST https://api.limitguard.ai/v1/keys/create with {"email": "you@example.com", "tier": "sandbox"} returns an lg_sandbox_ key; send it as X-API-Key for mock data at no charge.
Paying per call: call a priced operation with no credentials. It answers 402 with an x402 v2 challenge in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and the JSON body. Pay in USDC on Base or Solana and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
Prepaid: an lg_live_ key sent as X-API-Key is debited per call at the same prices instead. Buy balance with POST /v1/keys/upgrade/{tier}.
Operations with a dynamic price accept X-Response-Quality: cached, fresh or enhanced; fresh is the default, and an endpoint without a cached tier charges fresh.
Full guide: https://api.limitguard.ai/llms.txt

post.summary: Verify an entity across registries, sanctions and risk layers
post.description: Full entity trust check across multiple verification layers: KVK/CBE registry, OpenSanctions, country risk (CPI/FATF), domain WHOIS, IBAN validation and EU VAT/VIES. Returns trust score 0-100 with cluster and recommendation.

wallet_address.description: Crypto wallet address (format check only; no on-chain lookup)

wallet_chain.description: Blockchain the address is checked against (eth, base, polygon, arbitrum, btc, sol). Defaults to eth when omitted, so send btc or sol with a Bitcoin or Solana address

402.description: Payment required. The x402 v2 challenge is in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and the JSON body; pay and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, or send X-API-Key with prepaid balance.

post.summary: Check an entity for PEP ties, insolvency and adverse media
post.description: Extended screening in two tiers. fresh ($0.75): politically exposed person and relative/close-associate (role.pep / role.rca) matches from OpenSanctions, with the match detail the standard entity check does not return, plus a Dutch Centraal Insolventieregister screen (NL only). enhanced ($1.50): the same plus adverse media screening against a global news index. If a source of the requested tier cannot be reached the call returns 503 and is not charged.
